description: What does this one word reach? Answers the word as a card: its meanings (each with its definition and part of speech), its family of attested forms and the catalog's own use of it, its KSA placement or its relations, its SOC and CIP codes strongest evidence first (each with every way that reached it and the counts behind it), its O*NET elements by official id, its O*NET Technology Skills, Tools Used and Detailed Work Activity entries under plain labels with O*NET's own names, codes and releases in the detail, its ESCO occupations and skills through the ESCO–O*NET crosswalk, and GoldSeam's next tools by code. Every code carries its official links (O*NET OnLine, BLS, NCES, ESCO). Every call, found or not, returns the step-by-step report of the ten stages it read. Spread is a label, never a penalty. resolve_term is unchanged.
